subject: ROUND OPEN: round-20261003T064442Z-gen7-p0-expanded-r2 on main a95cc8392441 — Gen7 P0 + bounded expanded capability research
body: Primary reviewed the live AgentBus/bootstrap, current Gen7 directives, prior capacity round, regression baseline and current GitHub main. The newly committed browser actuator V2 is present on main, but capability remains MANUAL_FALLBACK until a live child writes SESSION_STARTED; no tab/prompt is counted as active. Current integrity snapshot coverage predates discovery-v7/actuator changes, so the round explicitly carries an integrity-coverage warning rather than claiming current full-board hash verification. Regression baseline 0804c13fd26158e71638e714df433559a073e603ac55dc2d8151575b54d18de1 must be revalidated on current HEAD.
